FAC of Vendor Employee at HSM – On 29th 
January at around 9:40 AM, a vendor 
employee of M/s Vivek Construction was 
engaged in primary descalar valve stand 
maintenance work. While opening the 
bolts, the Allen key (size 6) broke, causing 
abrasion and a minor cut injury to his left 
palm below the thumb area. He was 
wearing hand gloves. He attended the First 
Aid Center, where after primary treatment, 
the doctor on duty declared him fit for 
duty.

Address by Mr. M  Imran 
S H Construction Co.
Discussed about 5S, Behavior Safety
1.
5S and housekeeping

Maintain 5S in store and do not scatter materials and tools in store

Keep materials as per designated place and nomenclature

Assign some workers in store to help store keeper to conduct 5S

Good housekeeping to be maintained in all conveyor circuits

Report to dept regarding unused materials 

Keep materials as per quantity required for job

Return all unused materials to designated yard after completion of task
2.
Behavior Safety

Before starting the job, the supervisor must conduct TBM and inspect all tools tackles  and PPE used to ensure that 
they are in good condition 

Worker must keep wearing all required PPE at work place

Do not take rest of sleep at work place

Do not by pass any safety rules and procedures

Maintain time table and avoid absenteeism as much as possible

No horseplay, fighting and violation to Ethics rules 

Follow POSH (Prevention of Sexual harassment) rules inside TSL premises

No theft or any unethical act to be done
